text: Reviewed fd9da932a and issues #5429-#5433. The rewritten #5426 code commit 643f9b162 has the same tree c05380383 as 9c6dbbe82, contains the DCO Signed-off-by trailer, and exact-head Windows run 33460224805 is currently in progress; no code finding. Issue filing is substantively correct, with three wording corrections before implementation: (1) #5430 must not treat a simple identity-before/identity-after check as sufficient because an A->B->A swap can let B supply an intermediate signature/publisher result while both endpoint identities are A; bind each trust result to the retained object/identity. (2) #5432 core unmatched-quote plus cmd metacharacter injection concern stands, but remove the claim that percent expressions introduced by COPPERFIN_SCRIPT_WRAPPER_COMMAND are additionally/recursively expanded; the existing indirection is intentionally nonrecursive. (3) #5433 should focus on the demonstrable mutable/unpinned compiler input; typosquatting/MITM wording is speculative for the fixed Chocolatey package name and package-manager transport. No other findings in this poll.
